name: otp-input
title: OTP Input
description: Tactile split verification code input with recessed key wells, auto-focus progression, clipboard paste support, and full keyboard navigation.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface tier: clean default, raised tactile, or milled recessed well

props.name: mask
props.description: Hides numeric characters behind privacy dots

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Callback triggered when all digits are populated

examples.title: Tactile Verification Code
examples.description: 6-digit verification code with tactile keycap depth and clipboard support.
examples.code:
<OtpInput
  length={6}
  variant="tactile"
  onComplete={(code) => console.log('Entered code:', code)}
/>

examples.title: Recessed Well Tier
examples.description: Milled surface tier for high-security pin entry.
